title: QUIC Advisory msquic Peer-Blocked Evidence Classification Verification
preconditions: The updated current-status note is present.
The preserved major-peer evidence report is present.
The new requirement-home test file is present.
scope: Verify that the repository can formalize the msquic major-peer failures as peer-side blocked evidence without turning them into local transport support evidence.
procedure: Review `docs/current-status.md` and `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-INT.json` to confirm the slice is formalized.
Inspect the preserved major-peer evidence report for the peer-side outcome classes and msquic rows.
Run the focused requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0024`.
Confirm the current-status note still keeps the blocked cluster advisory and separate from the quic-go local candidate.
expected_result: The repository can keep the msquic major-peer failures classified as peer-side blocked evidence while leaving the local candidate set unchanged.
status_summary: Planned. The slice is advisory classification only and does not change runtime transport behavior.

supplemental_sections.heading: Scope
supplemental_sections.content: This verification only covers the blocked classification lane. It does not claim msquic support or a transport fix.
